			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_temple_school_tower value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_temple_school_tower value >= 2 } }
			OR = {

			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_temple_school_tower value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_temple_school_tower value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				var:tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_scale_tier ?= { this >= 3 }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_scale_tier }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_temple_school_tower value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_temple_school_tower value >= 4 } }

				var:tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_scale_tier ?= { this >= 4 }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_scale_tier }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_temple_school_tower value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_temple_school_tower value >= 5 } }

		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_arsenal_quarter_fortress value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_arsenal_quarter_fortress value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				var:tv_wonder_star_fortress_city_scale_tier ?= { this >= 2 }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_star_fortress_city_scale_tier }
			}

			}

		AND = {

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_locked_wonder_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_locked_wonder_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		tv_wonder_location_has_locked_wonder_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes
	}

tv_wonder_location_can_host_large_canal_system_trigger = {
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_project_building_trigger = yes }
	OR = {
		has_river = yes
		is_adjacent_to_lake = yes
		is_port = yes
	}
}

			is_adjacent_to_lake = yes
			is_port = yes
		}
	}
}

			tv_wonder_can_build_royal_art_district_trigger = yes
		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 31
			tv_wonder_can_build_grand_theater_festival_district_trigger = yes
		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 32
			tv_wonder_can_build_world_embassy_quarter_trigger = yes
		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 33
			tv_wonder_can_build_law_code_stele_project_trigger = yes
		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 34
			tv_wonder_can_build_world_market_trigger = yes
		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 35
			tv_wonder_can_build_royal_mint_system_trigger = yes
		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 36
			tv_wonder_can_build_guild_alliance_trigger = yes
		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 37
			tv_wonder_can_build_maritime_trade_station_network_trigger = yes
		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 38
			tv_wonder_can_build_giant_workshop_complex_trigger = yes
		}
		AND = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 39
			tv_wonder_can_build_world_monument_group_trigger = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_new_ceremony_ready_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	var:tv_wonder_locked ?= { this >= 19 }
	var:tv_wonder_locked ?= { this <= 39 }
}
